folds.subject: Snow Cover Is Decreasing
folds.why: Declining snow cover and earlier melting form a distinct climate impact a reader could navigate to directly.

folds.subject: Arctic Sea Ice
folds.why: The rapid decline in Arctic sea ice extent and thickness is a distinct climate impact.

folds.subject: Extreme Events Are Increasing in Frequency
folds.why: Temperature records and intense rainfall are distinct observable consequences of rising global temperatures.

folds.subject: Ocean Acidification
folds.why: Ocean chemistry change is a distinct topic from ocean warming, even though carbon absorption connects them.

folds.subject: Sea Level Is Rising
folds.why: Sea-level rise and its acceleration are distinct impacts a reader could seek directly.

folds.subject: Glaciers
folds.why: Glacier retreat is a distinct cryosphere change, separate from the Greenland and Antarctic ice sheets.
